QuantRule unified-ladder tutorial
=================================
Repository path: docs/tutorials/2026-10-30/unified-ladder.md

1. What this tutorial runs
2. Available versus active ladder
3. Inspect the tutorial config
4. Validate the policy envelope
5. Read the strategy in trader words
6. Walk the strategy
7. Run the full backtest
8. Read the executed strategy report
9. What the reports contain
10. Migrate a v2 strategy config
11. What this tutorial proves, and what it does not
12. Role labs

Start
  quantrule help
  quantrule policy check --config docs/tutorials/2026-10-30/config-state-fixture/run.json
  quantrule strategy explain --config docs/tutorials/2026-10-30/config-state-fixture/run.json
  quantrule strategy-run crates/quantrule-shell/tests/fixtures/state_m1.csv --strategy ladder-context --data-version tutorial:state:v1 --config docs/tutorials/2026-10-30/config-state-fixture/run.json
  quantrule backtest --config docs/tutorials/2026-10-30/config-state-fixture/run.json --out /tmp/quantrule-tutorial

Role labs
  Quant Researcher  docs/roles/2026-10-29/quant-researcher-manual.md
  Quant Developer   docs/roles/2026-10-29/quant-developer-manual.md
  Quant Validator   docs/roles/2026-10-29/quant-validator-manual.md

Paths are relative to the repository root.
